name: Dhaulpur

queries.query: Dhaulpur Rajasthan official cadastral parcel map GIS land records DILRMP
queries.result: First-party discovery found Rajasthan e-Dharti land-records, Rajasthan Bhu-Naksha cadastral-map service, the Rajasthan Rajdharaa urban GIS portal, and the Government of India DILRMP progress page. DILRMP explicitly lists DHOLPUR and cadastral-map progress, but no anonymous Dhaulpur parcel API response was obtained.

queries.result: हिंदी आधिकारिक परिणामों ने राजस्थान भू-नक्शा, ई-धरती और राजधरा शहरी GIS पोर्टल की पुष्टि की। धौलपुर/धोलपुर के लिए सार्वजनिक सुरक्षित पार्सल-ID और पूर्ण ज्यामिति वाला अनाम उत्तर सत्यापित नहीं हुआ; खोज परिणाम और आधिकारिक पृष्ठ केवल मानचित्र/अभिलेख सेवा की उपलब्धता बताते हैं।

registryEvidence.custodian: Rajasthan Revenue Board / Settlement Department and Department of Land Resources modernization system; Rajasthan e-Dharti and Bhu-Naksha are the official state land-record/cadastral-map services.
registryEvidence.basis: Official Rajasthan e-Dharti describes public agricultural land-record access and identifies the Revenue Board/Settlement administration. Official Bhu-Naksha is the state cadastral-map viewer. DILRMP's official progress page names DHOLPUR in cadastral-map reporting. This evidences a state/district cadastral custodian, not a verified open Dhaulpur parcel geometry endpoint.

officialSources.observation: Official Rajasthan e-Dharti page states that Jamabandi copies are available under agricultural land records and identifies the Revenue Board and Settlement Commissioner contacts.
officialSources.scope: State land-record access/procedure; no safe anonymous parcel polygon was returned.

officialSources.observation: Official Rajasthan Bhu-Naksha cadastral-map viewer page was identified by first-party discovery; direct retrieval timed out in this attempt.
officialSources.scope: State cadastral viewer; current API/schema/CRS and Dhaulpur geometry were not verified.

officialSources.observation: Official Rajdharaa Urban GIS shell exposes Khasra search and states that khasra/village boundaries come from the Settlement Department.
officialSources.scope: Urban GIS viewer; its inspected current configuration points to JDA/Jaipur services, not a Dhaulpur layer.

officialSources.observation: Official DILRMP MIS search result reports a DHOLPUR row with cadastral-map progress.
officialSources.scope: Progress reporting only; not an anonymous parcel geometry service.

requests.outcome: Official HTML fetched; public page exposes land-record service description, disclaimer, and state custodian contacts. No parcel geometry endpoint was exposed in the retrieved shell.

Official viewer URL was identified, but fetch returned a gateway failure through the research route. No retry with disabled TLS, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, login, credentials, or private token was attempted.
Official Urban GIS HTML shell fetched. Khasra controls are present, but this is not evidence of Dhaulpur coverage.
Current JavaScript configuration inspected. Khasra service is JDA/Settlement_JDA and other services are Jaipur/JDA-specific; no Dhaulpur service was exposed.
Not queried for features because the current configuration identifies this as JDA/Jaipur-specific and not a Dhaulpur source; no city point was shifted and no irrelevant geometry was retained.
Official DILRMP endpoint was identified in discovery; direct fetch returned a gateway failure. Search-result content still evidenced a DHOLPUR progress row, but no parcel response was requested.

schemaCrs.details: No anonymous Dhaulpur parcel response was obtained; native field schema, stable parcel identity, geometry encoding, CRS, and bounded feature count remain unverified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Rajasthan state cadastral and land-record systems with Dholpur named in official DILRMP progress reporting.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous public Dhaulpur parcel ID-plus-geometry response or city-scoped public cadastral layer was verified.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [26.7014103659841,77.8902844733414] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted to force a parcel hit.
Dholpur/Dhaulpur is evidenced in official state/national land-record context, but the evidence does not establish citywide open parcel coverage.
The Bhu-Naksha gateway failure and any unavailable viewer/API are access limitations, not evidence of cadastral absence.
The Jaipur/JDA Rajdharaa configuration was not treated as a Dhaulpur source.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account, personal, transaction, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion does not represent source integration or admission.
remainingUncertainty: The official Bhu-Naksha/e-Dharti services may expose Dhaulpur parcel maps through a route not reachable or not exposed in the inspected anonymous shell. Local tehsil/village coverage, native identifiers, CRS, and citywide public geometry remain unknown.
